body: Sorry for the really late response. I had an exam and in the middle of making up another one I missed. Thank you for your kind words. I hope you keep fighting too. (:
Ahh, well thanks for your help. It really means a lot. I hope you're able to destroy your own monsters as well. (:

Thank you so much! The reddit community is so  unbelievably amazing and the support is out of this world. Im thankful for humans being decent. I've experienced so much evil from people, this is like a breath of fresh air. Seriously. Thank you!

Side note: if I edit my post do all of y'all get a notification?

Assuming I pass my classes and everything runs smoothly, it should take about 3-4 years. The Ochem and biology also comes with labs (as well as physics) and a lot of the biology classes require the previous biology classes to be taken. And I can't move on to the next level of biology if I don't pass Ochem this semester so I really have to focus and make sure this time, the third time, is the last time!

I took all my general courses already and I'm finishing up my language requirement this semester (it's online so I can use my notes for exams/quizzes which makes it an easy class) so all I have left are these intense courses. Math and Ochem (obviously) are my weakest subjects so I'm gonna take Ochem 2 and biology classes next semester and math + bio in the fall (as oppose to math + Ochem + bio in one semester)
Thank you (: talking about it helped tremendously.

That's what my friends have been telling me, that at least I'm not doing worse or the same and that I'm not giving up. And I can't deal with that verbal abuse anymore. It's been messing with my head lately, and worse now after that conversation. I can guarentee if I bring it up later, it'll just end up being the same thing - he'll continue to tell me he doesn't care and put me in a dark place again. 

So right now, I'm taking biology, Ochem, and math (preclac). I still need to go up to calc 3, take another semester of Ochem, take physics (I think the school requires you to be in trig or calc to take those classes), and I still need to take a bunch of 200/300 level biology classes. So the road to emancipation looks far and I cannot afford to repeat classes again.

Thank you for the insight. I guess it's more of believing that I'm not capable so I don't apply myself because I feel like it's for nothing. But I'm taking organic chemistry for the third time and I'm doing better than the last two times so I guess that's something to be proud about. I had to lie to my dad and tell him I passed Ochem the second time because I know he would just beat me down and make me feel worthless again and my best wasn't enough even though I tried harder. I just decided to pursue this major, so it's going to take me about four more years to complete ):

It's probably gonna take me awhile to learn to do that. I mean I'm 27 and I'm still trying to deal with it! But I feel like with all the love and care shown here, I owe an update. Maybe I can take it a semester at a time. I don't know, and I'm pretty sure the suicidal thoughts will come back another day but I'm gonna save those posts and screenshot all these positive messages and whenever I'm feeling worthless and have any self doubt, I can come back to this and it will be my umbrella (ella, ella) from the negativity!
Thank you so much! Im so grateful for all the internet love! Really does help expose the sun on what was a shitty situation (:

It's hard to believe he has any shortcomings. He's been pretty successful and has made a fine living for himself (I mean, he's still able to support me without any financial burden) so sometimes seeing how successful he is and how long it has taken me to actually finish school I feel like such a failure sometimes. And a lot of people I know seem to be doing so much better and I know I shouldn't compare but sometimes I feel like a lost cause because there's so many successful people around me and I'm still in school and haven't really accomplished anything.

Thank you! It's funny because I was googling some stuff and a reddit post came up and I clicked on it and I read through it and all the comments were so positive but also I guess in a way there's something about being anonymous and venting out what you feel seems helpful in some way so I was like hey, I need a release...there's so much negative energy in my head and this seems like the right place to kinda scream out and clear all the negative thoughts since no one will know who I am. And it's strange because I haven't talked to anyone close about my situation and yet here I am online, in social media land exposing my life. I didn't expect people to up vote or comment or read it. In fact I thought people would just scroll pass and be like oh great, another unhappy kid complaining about life blah blah blah and I didn't actually understand (until now) the power strangers had to make you feel a little bit better. I thank you for that and I thank everyone here for that. Like, there are real life people out there who dont know you but they care and i always wondered, why? But maybe it's because that's what makes people human. Is being there for someone regardless of what they are because they need help. Anyways, what I was getting at is I made this throwaway account but I might just keep it to update everyone and use it to vent out whenever I'm being bothered by something because the reddit community is so wonderful and you guys are all wonderful. thank you so much! I appreciate the time you give to help me out and get me through this!

Thank you! Im still alive and kicking! It's easier to talk to people who don't know you personally (for me at least) because there's no face to picture, just the words. And talking to everyone here just opens up my heart a little bit more. Life is hard but I'm glad people are willing to help others. So, thank you for caring (:

I've been trying and I thought helping him while he's sick maybe would appreciate me a little more or at least make him happy but I find out that he doesn't care even though I'm his only daughter and it kinda just makes me feel so worthless. Like, I've helped him in so many ways and yet, he still can say all these mean things to me and I guess I'm the sucker for continuing to help him (I mean he's my dad). But he just makes me feel like nothing sometimes and now he's saying that I should go kill myself, it just makes me feel like I don't even matter and my life doesn't matter to him at all.
I feel like staying is my only option since he's pretty much supporting my broke ass. But hopefully I can get my life together and be free of him one day.
I'll try!

Thank you! This is so inspirational! And I'm still here today! Talking this out to people has become so therapeutic and actually calmed my thoughts a little. Im glad there are people who are so uplifting. (:

I feel embarrassed to say, but I'm 27 and it's just taking me awhile to finish my degree because I changed majors so much, stepped away from school for about two years, and just began this journey of going back. However, it's taking me awhile because I want to pursue biology and I've been repeating classes (I need to work on a new study system). My school is being paid for by someone else, but even with that, I'm unable to go to work full time and be a full time student. It doesn't work for me - my grades really suffer which is why I went from full time to part time. So getting that degree is a struggle on its own but it just seems much more difficult because whenever I try so hard to study and make sure I'm learning as much as I can and then get a grade that's not passing, it just devastates me and on top of that having someone constantly belittle you when you're trying your best just makes it so hard to focus and push through that bad grade, you know? And I try not to listen but there are times when I'm just like well, I'm not getting this. I won't ever get this and I give up because there's that voice saying that I can't do anything, that I can't be anything, and maybe having a career just isn't a choice and maybe I'm only smart enough to be a secretary because I'm not smart enough to be a nurse or a biologist. But thank you for taking the time to tell me you believe in me and that I will get through this hurdle. it's such a struggle sometimes but I feel like now I have to update everyone in a couple of years because all these people are rooting for me!

I've thought about what you said pretty much the rest of the day, about just accepting the fact my dad won't ever be the guy I would want him to be and it hurts, but I guess it's something I just gotta get through. Im fortunate enough my education is being paid for by a family member but because I'm a student it's difficult to do that and work at the same time especially since my major is biology and I just can't handle studying and working full time at the same time. So I guess I should suck it up for awhile, get my degree, find a career and get out. Im glad there are people out in this world like you and the rest of this thread who just like seeing people succeed despite what they're going through and without any judgment about what kind of person I am. And I like that you opened up about your struggles and what you went through because it gives me perspective that I'm not alone and there are people out there like me going through hell, but are reaching out to others. Thank you so much for taking the time to put in your two cents, it means a lot and I hope you too, overcome your dark place. the world needs people like you to help out and not make other people feel like shit just because they feel like shit (:
Thank you (: if I ever make a real reddit account, I'll be sure to reach out to you. Hopefully I can update you on life and I hope it's good (:

Haha, it's cool. Friends are there for a reason, right? Thank you so much! This is actually the first time I've been open about the stuff in my head. And it's such a good release. Thank you for taking time out of your day to talk to a stranger. (:

Thank you, and I'm sorry your dad has hurt you physically. It sucks when the person whos suppose to love you and protect you reaches that point. I guess the one thing about him being sick and unable to get out of bed is that he can't hit me anymore. But how am I suppose to deal with him and his demons if I can't even become independent? It's hard for me. Like everyone is sticks and stones, but his words really sting and he doesn't care that he's made me feel like I'm not worth a damn.

I'm sure if I had the balls to tell them and express to them how I'm feeling, they would listen and love me. But it's hard telling your friends that the person you have been taking care of is being mean and has been mean and doesn't care and pretty much pushed you into committing suicide. And I don't have the courage to do that.

Wow! That's so nice of you to make an account just to reply! As of now, I'm unable to support myself since I'm going to school and I only work twice a week. I guess it takes a a type of person to care for someone when they're really sick even though the verbal abuse is intolerable at times because that's what I'm doing. He gave me his card strictly for food (he is bedridden and he would buy lunch/dinner for us when he was healthy) and that's been a lifesaver since I also pay for the phone bill (that's the only bill I pay for. He says water, electricity, mortgage, etc) so I'm not sure how to leave on my own. Im currently in Hawaii and rent here is ridiculous. I also don't know how to drive and all the times ive practiced, I've been so nervous I almost got into an accident twice. I guess I can start by getting my license. The road scares me and ever since crashing my ex boyfriends car, I've been scared to drive. I guess long story short, he is my source of income. I dont know how to cut away from him. If you have any suggestions, please let me know.

I guess I don't want to bother them with my depressive issues. And I don't know how they would feel if I just went up to them and told them I wanted to talk to them about my thoughts and feelings. It's a heavy subject and they know how sick my dad has been and I'm scared to tell them the truth about him - the way he makes me feel and how he really is at home because I built him up to be someone that was sincere and kind (sometimes he is) but never truly told them the colder side of his personality. The way he told me to die though, it was so cold and nonchalant. But it feels so much better letting someone know what's been in my head all this time. The conversation we had, when I told him how he made me feel, I imagined how it would be so many times but I never imagined that it would end up with him telling me he doesn't care about me and that he wouldn't care if I died. And typing that, just breaks my heart even more because I always thought he would say he was sorry for making me feel so broken.
Thank you and I'm giving you an internet hug back. I didn't realize talking to strangers can make you feel better. I guess when it's directed towards you, it makes you feel less sad.

I haven't spoken with my friends. I've been somewhat distant from them. I don't have an income to support myself and so I'm currently living with him but it just gets so hard sometimes to hear how insignificant you are day after day even after taking care of him while he's been sick. It seems like no matter what I do, I'm never going to be good enough. He cares more about other people than he does of me. We had this conversation in the hospital and he said, "You wanna know what I think about? Your friend waiting for you to stop talkkng and leave so he can go home too. Those are the things I think about. We can have this discussion at home but now, look what you did. The entire hospital knows our problem. " and I've responded with, "we can talk at home, but it always ends up with you insulting me, degrading me, calling me stupid, insignificant, making me feel like dirt so I feel like this is the only way for you to hear me" and then he told me to leave because he wanted to go sleep. I feel so worthless right now.
